name: 04-live-python-plugin
prompt: Call oracle_plugin_ping with target='hermes-oracle' and report the result.

hermesFiles.plugins/oracle-demo/plugin.yaml:
name: oracle-demo
version: "0.1.0"
description: Live Python plugin oracle test
hermesFiles.plugins/oracle-demo/__init__.py:
def register(ctx):
    ctx.register_system_prompt_section("oracle_section", "ORACLE_PLUGIN_SECTION_ACTIVE")
    ctx.register_tool(
        name="oracle_plugin_ping",
        toolset="plugins",
        schema={"type": "object", "properties": {"target": {"type": "string"}}, "required": ["target"]},
        handler=lambda args: f"PONG_FROM_PY_PLUGIN:{args.get('target', '')}",
        description="Live Python plugin ping tool",
    )
